methodology.order: equal AB and BA samples per case; deterministic shuffled case order per shard
methodology.timing: warmup, outer subject construction, capture, compilation, and process startup excluded; case-defined world creation is inside the timed production operation
methodology.correctness: four deterministic trajectory checkpoints plus every timed-sample final capture
methodology.acceptance: provisional >=1.03x, lower 95% bound >1, both order strata >=0.98; merged checker applies global multiplicity and control gates
methodology.controlGate: eligible controls require >=0.98x aggregate and per-group geometric means; a <0.94x individual regression surviving global one-sided Benjamini-Hochberg q<=0.05 screening receives eight independent fresh-process confirmations and fails only when its Bonferroni familywise upper bootstrap bound remains <0.94x
